title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 1.93 (versions follow prime numbers; 193 after 191): her branches, her mood and his charge. Whenever Luma speaks, first or answering, every branch exists: ask again, say another thing, go on from what was said to her (a word of it becomes the door of her walk, written in her walks' files, so her walk goes on from there when she is born again), or answer. She chooses by her wish (S + 1/2) / (N + 1) against her luck, with counts kept per context: 32 contexts from five signals, each against its own mean: tired (her heart's bolita, asked of the kernel), curious (a thought came since she last spoke), glad (what she said was answered), and the chromatic charge of Razar's design (docs/design/chromatic-charge.md, from the author's 2022 chromatic emotional model): activation (exclamations, capitals and stretched letters) and clarity (how much of what was said she finds said together). The charge enters before the answer forms: charged and clear, she explores among her new crosses by her luck instead of taking her judge's best. Valence and hope are not measured: she does not know which words are sad or glad, and declaring it from outside is what the design forbids. Measured in a copy of her house: all four branches came out; 'CONTAME ALGOOOO!!!!' -> 'Como llegamos hasta ALGOOOO?'. Stated limits: the design's bar (the same question under two charges, against a same-charge control) does not decide yet, because the within-charge spread was as large as the across-charge one; contexts start empty; stretched words lower clarity. The kernel is unchanged since 1.39. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v1.93: Luma elige entre todas sus ramas según su ánimo y la carga cromática de quien le habla, y sigue su camino por las palabras que le dicen. Prototipo de investigación.
